headline: People Incorporated to Participate in the Oppenheimer 29th Annual Technology, Internet & Communications Conference
summary: People Incorporated (NASDAQ: PPLI) will participate in the Oppenheimer 29th Annual Technology, Internet & Communications Conference on Wednesday, August 12, 2026. Timothy Quinn, CFO of People Incorporated, will participate in a fireside chat at 10:45 a.m. ET. Both a live webcast and replay of the fireside chat will be available to the public on People Incorporated's website at https://ir.people-incorporated.com/events-and-presentations/events.
